name: Devoted to the Sun cuts Solar Invocation cooldowns by 5 seconds (#2228)
contract: Devoted to the Sun 681066 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 33) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11), EffectSpellClassMask word A = 294912 (bits 15 and 18), word B = 128 (bit 7), word C = 524290 (bits 1 and 19), EffectBasePoints -5001 resolving to -5000 (milliseconds). The four Solar Invocation spells the module's own Invocation() helper (AscensionSunCleric.cpp) recognizes each carry a matching bit: Conquest 800764 (word C = 524288, bit 19), Ascension 500152 (word B = 128, bit 7), Revelation 503651 (word A = 262144, bit 18) and Resplendence 806159 (word A = 262144, bit 18). SpellInfo::IsAffected(33, mask) admits all four. Native path: Player::ApplySpellMod(spellInfo->Id, SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, recovery, spell) (Player.cpp) is called whenever any of these spells' cooldown is set, with no script required. This scenario drives that call through the harness's spell_modifier metric.
